sec.title: Background
sec.p: Background prose recognized as the introduction via the synonym pattern. Subarachnoid haemorrhage outcomes vary with vasospasm severity.

sec.title: Subjects and Methods
sec.p: We enrolled forty-two participants in a retrospective cohort study. Diffusion tensor imaging was performed on a three Tesla scanner.

sec.title: Experimental Procedures
sec.p: Tissue samples were stained with haematoxylin and eosin and photographed at twenty times magnification.

sec.title: Findings
sec.p: Fractional anisotropy was reduced in the corpus callosum of affected subjects.

sec.title: Conclusions
sec.p: Diffusion tensor imaging detects subclinical white matter injury in this cohort. Further longitudinal study is warranted.
